title: Eva Marie Saint, Oscar Winner for ‘On the Waterfront,’ Is Dead at 102
summary: A luminous beauty with dramatic depth, she brought a layered intensity to harrowing roles and seduced Cary Grant in the romantic thriller “North by Northwest.”
